_note: Example only. Copy outside the repo and fill the <...> values. Commands are argv lists; no shell. With no active version a new one starts only when the run behind the latest accepted version has ended (run_receipt_command: read-only, prints that run's receipt.json fields) or after daily_fallback in timezone (22:20 Asia/Shanghai: after the collector's 21:35 budget, before the next day's 01:00 run), at most one automatic start per local day. A one-off catch-up or migration uses the manual --force-new-batch flag, which does not use that daily slot; there is deliberately no force key here. With an active version, timezone/daily_fallback/run_receipt_command are not required: it resumes from its frozen material.
root: <local delivery state dir (ledger.json, manifests/, artifacts/, versions/)>
